hypothesis.description: Approximate one fixed RBF kernel over contemporaneous public temperature/salinity, cyclic time, and queried depth, then solve a globally regularized ridge model. This tests smooth nonlinear state-to-profile mapping without local neighbors, tree routing, or adaptive scalar blends.

model.training_mask: all eight public scalars finite and queried target temp+psal jointly finite; timestamp at or before exact eligible prefix terminal
model.robust_scaling: training median and IQR/1.349 per feature, standard-deviation then one fallback, clip [-12,12]
model.kernel_approximation: sklearn RBFSampler with gamma=1/15, n_components=128, one independent map per registered seed
model.seed_aggregation: prediction mean before metric and common postprocess
model.missing_public_fallback: sealed Stage-A prediction_mean for the affected target row
model.postprocess: pinned public-endpoint isotonic profile projection then CSV float roundtrip

lineage_disclosure.distinct_from_failed_rank2_point_analog: global RBF feature expectation with a single regularized solve; no nearest-neighbor selection or local affine profile projection
lineage_disclosure.distinct_from_failed_oas_gaussian: nonlinear stationary kernel map rather than a linear conditional covariance
lineage_disclosure.distinct_from_tree_and_deep_reference: closed-form shallow kernel estimator with no boosting, neural sequence encoder, router, or component stack
